Data will now be imported to[n]your new game. This data is[n]comprised of:
Social stats, Persona Compendium,[n]equipment, money, total playtime,[n]teammates' Persona development...
Analyzed information, skill cards,[n]max HP and SP, challenge battles...
Customized guns, darts sets,[n]fishing poles, Perma-Picks,[n]number of stamps found...
Lastly, you will re-acquire any[n]special items received from your[n]Confidant relationships.
